There is one case can cause data corruption.
- write 4k to fileA
- fsync fileA
- write 4k to fileA
- kworker flushs 4k to lbaB; dnode contain lbaB didn't be persisted yet
- write 4k to fileB
- kworker flush 4k to lbaA due to SSR
- SPOR -> dnode with lbaA will be recovered
data
One solution is tracking all fsynced file's block history
SSR overwrite on newly invalidated block on that file.
However
column3: no matter the dnode is flushed or fsynced

column1: previous dnodes until last fsynced one in node chain can be recovered
that means we need to record all block change in flushed dnode
will cause heavy cost
column2: so let's just use simple fix by forbidding SSR

column1: overwrite directly.
